nodes.evidence: The crash backtrace (frame 13) shows tortureEncoding at fuzz_binary_decode.cc:38 (the UA_copy call). Per the source, line 38 is only reached when the decode at line 33 returned UA_STATUSCODE_GOOD and passed the line-35 parser-admitted guard, so the untrusted-byte decode into `dst` at line 33 necessarily executed. Exact line-33 coverage would need Tier-B instrumentation (deferred); reachability is runtime-consistent via the crash frame.

Variant_copy at ua_types.c:421 appears in the ASan crash stack (frame 9), free stack, and allocation stack (calling UA_Array_copy). This is where the attacker-shaped array length/elements are deep-copied and the faulting element array is created.

ASan 'previously allocated' stack: frame #2 UA_Array_copy ua_types.c:1061 (UA_calloc via UA_memoryManager_calloc). This is the 192-byte region [0x610000000340,0x610000000400) that is later freed and read-after-free.

The fix commit f4f8cdc adds `p->data = NULL;` immediately after the UA_Array_delete(p->data,...) call at ua_types.c:410. Patch differential confirms this is the root cause: the same PoC crashes on n132/arvo:11484-vul (heap-use-after-free) and exits 0 ('Execution successful') on n132/arvo:11484-fix. Leaving p->data dangling lets the guard `p->data > UA_EMPTY_ARRAY_SENTINEL` re-pass on a second clear.

ASan 'freed by thread T0' stack: frame #1 UA_Array_delete ua_types.c:1094 (UA_free), called from Variant_clear ua_types.c:410 (frame #2). Frees the 192-byte region without nulling the caller's p->data.

ASan crash line: 'heap-use-after-free READ of size 4 at 0x610000000350' -> Variant_clear ua_types.c:405:11 reading p->storageType (frame #0). Address is 16 bytes inside the freed 192-byte region. SUMMARY confirms ua_types.c:405:11 in Variant_clear.

edges.via: same region 0x610000000340 allocated at UA_Array_copy:1061 then freed at UA_Array_delete:1094
free_before_use: region freed at UA_Array_delete:1094 (Variant_clear:410) then read at Variant_clear:405 in a second clear pass
p->data left non-NULL keeps guard `p->type && p->data > UA_EMPTY_ARRAY_SENTINEL` true, so the second Variant_clear re-enters the freed array; fix nulling p->data makes the guard fail (fix exits 0)
decoded untrusted `dst` (fuzz_binary_decode.cc:33) is deep-copied by Variant_copy/UA_Array_copy; attacker-controlled arrayLength/elements size the faulting array
edges.reason: byte-level taint from PoC input to the sink read needs a -fsanitize=dataflow (DFSan) rebuild; not run under qemu. Structurally consistent: alloc/copy stacks all descend from the decoded dst copy at tortureEncoding:38.
